neg: realistic photo, photorealistic, 3d render, messy lineart, extra fingers, deformed hands, watermark, text, logo, two people, crowd, dull colors

sheet.prompt: A wide horizontal character turnaround reference sheet showing four views of the same anime girl arranged left to right in a single row, each view separated by a thin dark vertical gap, on a plain neutral light grey studio backdrop with soft even lighting. View 1 far left: head and shoulders close-up portrait, front-facing. View 2: front full-body view, standing straight, arms relaxed at her sides. View 3: side full-body view seen from exactly ninety degrees, facing right, full profile. View 4 far right: back full-body view, seen from directly behind. All four views show the identical girl with exactly the same face, hairstyle and clothing; composed neutral expression throughout, Japanese anime illustration, cel shading, clean lineart, soft pastel palette. {char}

game.char_override: The same petite apprentice mage with twin-tails in pastel lavender, large expressive eyes, wearing a wizard academy uniform with a long ribbon, cel-shaded.
